And Then There Were None gains much of its effect from sequence. Setup creates expectations; complications test those expectations; revelations or emotional turns force revision. The most useful character question is not whether someone is simply good, bad, right, or wrong. This keeps And Then There Were None from being flattened into a moral diagram. It also makes room for contradiction: people can be perceptive in one area and self-deceiving in another, loyal yet controlling, frightened yet reckless, sincere while still causing harm, or confident while misunderstanding the situation.
